Open Mic Night — The Deli, Norman

Join us every Tuesday for open mic night at The Deli in Norman! Sign-ups
start at 6:30pm, sets go up at 7. This is an unpaid, no-cover event, but
it's a great room — we regularly have local bookers and venue owners in
the crowd scouting for their own rooms, and a few regulars have landed
paid gigs after playing our stage.

Bring your own instrument; we provide a PA and a house piano.
